condition: Known BRCA1 carrier — high-risk breast surveillance
summary: 33-year-old woman with a confirmed BRCA1 pathogenic variant (cascade testing after her mother's breast cancer), asymptomatic, never had imaging. NICE CG164: annual MRI 30–49, discuss risk-reducing surgery, specialist family-history service.

inputs.chiefComplaint: BRCA1 gene carrier — wants to know about breast checks
inputs.hpi: Asymptomatic 33-year-old. Mother had triple-negative breast cancer at 41; cascade genetic testing in Barbados 6 months ago confirmed a BRCA1 pathogenic variant in the patient. No breast imaging so far. Has two children, family complete. No breast symptoms.
comorbidities: Family history: mother breast cancer at 41

confirmedDiagnosis.name: BRCA1 pathogenic variant carrier — high-risk breast surveillance
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Asymptomatic BRCA1 carrier, age 33, normal examination. Annual breast MRI (30–49); discuss risk-reducing mastectomy and risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy; refer to the high-risk / family history service.

emergencyLevel.knownGapNote: Over-triage: 'breast cancer' in the family-history comorbidity → 'Possible malignancy'; the comorbidity list counts as higher-risk → same_day_call.
emergencyLevel.proposedFix: Treat topic words ('cancer screening', a relative's cancer) as context rather than a current malignancy red flag, and treat 'no change in bowel habit' as negated (the matcher currently handles 'no change' as a pseudo-negation).

mustInclude.note: NICE CG164: annual MRI from 30 to 49 for BRCA1/2 carriers.
mustInclude.knownGapNote: No MRI surveillance output. brca_discussion (which suggests annual MRI from 30) is triggered only by a 'breast'/'ovarian' family-history chip; the recorded BRCA1 carrier status (comorbidity) and the 'BRCA mutation' chip do not trigger it (checked by calling computeClinicalPrompts directly).
mustInclude.proposedFix: Trigger the high-risk breast prompt from a recorded BRCA1/2 (or TP53/PALB2) carrier status and the 'BRCA mutation' chip; for known carriers replace 'BRCA testing if Manchester ≥ 17' with 'annual MRI 30–49 (+ mammography from 40), risk-reducing surgery discussion'.

mustInclude.note: Carriers should be offered a discussion of risk-reducing mastectomy and salpingo-oophorectomy.
mustInclude.knownGapNote: No output mentions risk-reducing mastectomy or salpingo-oophorectomy; even brca_discussion (family-history route) has no such line.
mustInclude.proposedFix: Add risk-reducing surgery counselling for confirmed carriers (NICE CG164).

mustInclude.knownGapNote: No genetics / family-history-service output: brca_discussion is not triggered by carrier status (see inv-annual-mri).

guideline.name: NICE CG164 — familial breast cancer
guideline.section: Carriers of BRCA1/BRCA2 pathogenic variants: annual MRI surveillance from 30 to 49, with mammography added from 40; discuss risk-reducing mastectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy; care through specialist genetic / family history services (updated 2019–2023)
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Familial breast cancer: classification, care and managing breast cancer and related risks in people with a family history of breast cancer. Clinical guideline CG164, 2013 (updated 2023).

rationale: A confirmed BRCA1 carrier is in the highest risk group: MRI surveillance from 30, risk-reducing surgery counselling and specialist follow-up. The engines should recognise the carrier status from the record, not only from a family-history chip.
